result.question: What does Zebul tell Gaal to do?

readings.answer: Go out now and fight them
readings.support: Go out now and fight them!

assessments.reason: The answer quotes Zebul’s instruction, “Go out now and fight them,” which in context refers to fighting Abimelech and his forces; the next verse confirms Gaal fought Abimelech.
